description: List per-email metrics across the account: one row per campaign and per sequence email step, each with its own delivery funnel, attributed conversions, and revenueCents. This is the tool for cross-sequence questions - 'how many Email 4s went out across these sequences' is one call with step=4 plus the returned totals, instead of one get_sequence_stats per sequence. Sequence rows carry sequenceId, sequenceName, automationNodeId, and step, so you can group or compare steps yourself. Counts come from the retained event stream (not the 14-day list_email_sends history) and match get_sequence_stats steps[] for the same step. Filter by emailType, sequenceId, campaignId, and step; sort with sort/order; page with page/limit. totals covers every matching email, not just the current page.

campaignId.description: Optional campaign IDs to restrict the breakdown to. Cannot be combined with sequenceId, step, or emailType sequence.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

emailType.description: Optional email type: campaign or sequence. Defaults to both. Implied as sequence when sequenceId or step is set.

end.description: Optional ISO 8601 custom range end. Must be provided with start; maximum range is 90 days. Omit start and end for all-time counts over the full retained window.

includeMachineEngagement.description: If true, include machine-classified bot/scanner opens and clicks. Defaults to false, so metrics and activity are human-only.

limit.description: Emails per page. Defaults to 50; maximum 500.

order.description: Sort order: asc or desc. Defaults to desc.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Defaults to 1.

period.description: Optional sliding window: 1h, 24h, 7d, 30d, or 90d. Ignored when start and end are provided. Omit for all-time counts.

sequenceId.description: Optional sequence IDs to restrict the breakdown to. Omit for every sequence in the account. Cannot be combined with campaignId.

sort.description: Sort field: sent, delivered, opened, clicked, openRate, clickRate, unsubscribed, conversions, revenue, step, or name. Defaults to sent.

start.description: Optional ISO 8601 custom range start. Must be provided with end.

step.description: Optional 1-based email step position to keep, counted in graph order per sequence. step 4 keeps only the fourth email of each sequence. Sequence emails only.

name: list_email_metrics

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `list_email_metrics` MCP tool.

emails.description: One entry per email in scope: each campaign and each sequence email step, sorted by the requested sort/order.

items.description: Metrics for one campaign or one sequence email step.

automationNodeId.description: Automation node ID of this step, or null for campaigns. Pass it as automationNodeId to list_sequence_events or list_email_sends to reach the recipients behind these counts.

campaignId.description: Campaign ID, or null for sequence emails.

conversions.description: Attributed conversions credited to this email.

emailId.description: Stable identifier: the campaign ID for campaigns, the automation node ID for sequence emails.

emailType.description: Whether this row is a campaign or a sequence email.

name.description: Campaign name, or the sequence step's subject line falling back to its node label.

revenueCents.description: Attributed revenue in minor currency units credited to this email.

sequenceId.description: Sequence ID, or null for campaigns.

sequenceName.description: Name of the sequence this step belongs to, or null for campaigns.

stats.description: Delivery funnel for this email alone. `opened` and `clicked` are unique counts deduplicated by email send (one recipient opening five times counts once), not total open events. Every count is attributed to the sends made inside the requested window, including engagement that arrives after the window ends, so `opened <= delivered <= sent` always holds. Rates use `rateDenominator` (`delivered`, or `sent` when no delivery events were recorded, reported as `rateDenominatorBasis`); `deliveryRate` and `bounceRate` divide by `sent`.

step.description: 1-based position of this email in its sequence, counted in graph order, or null for campaigns. Matches the step number in get_sequence_stats steps[].

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

order.description: Sort order the response was ordered by.

sequenceIds.description: Echo of the sequence IDs the breakdown was scoped to, present only when scoped.

sort.description: Sort field the response was ordered by.

step.description: Echo of the step filter, present only when one was requested.

totals.description: Summed funnel across every email matching the filters, not just the returned page, plus `emails` (the number of matching emails), `conversions`, and `revenueCents`. Read totals.sent for "how many of this step went out in total". `opened` and `clicked` are unique counts deduplicated by email send (one recipient opening five times counts once), not total open events. Every count is attributed to the sends made inside the requested window, including engagement that arrives after the window ends, so `opened <= delivered <= sent` always holds. Rates use `rateDenominator` (`delivered`, or `sent` when no delivery events were recorded, reported as `rateDenominatorBasis`); `deliveryRate` and `bounceRate` divide by `sent`.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
